task: TASK-027 -- acquire the pinned GDC DR45.0 TCGA-UCEC cohort (542 files) + repeat FREEZE A from scratch on the materialized files. HALT before Freeze B.
scope_statement: This task DOWNLOADED the pinned 507 primary + 35 normal STAR-Counts files, verified every md5/size against the frozen pins, and re-ran the INPUT feasibility freeze (Freeze A) from scratch on the materialized files. NO biological scoring: no expression VALUE (tpm/count/fpkm) was read into any score, contrast, module, ranking, fold-change, or statistic. Structural file checks only (header columns, 4 STAR summary rows, GENCODE-v36 gene-row count). Freeze B was NOT entered.

git.note: No Git write operation was performed. Acquisition artifacts were generated in an isolated workspace. Pre-existing repository changes were not modified.

environment.third_party_packages: NONE -- all scripts use the Python standard library only (csv, hashlib, os, re, sys, time, json, urllib, collections). No venv created; no pip install needed.
environment.curl: 8.5.0 (used only for GDC /status GET and a one-file connectivity/md5 sanity test)
environment.seed: N/A -- fully deterministic (no randomness enters selection, join, checksums, or structural validation)

source.release_drift: NONE -- live GDC /status returned exactly DR45.0 / commit 8f7c2a51 / tag 8.5.0; identical to the pinned checkpoint. Pinned UUIDs all resolved and served byte-exact.

selection_rule.usage: applied VERBATIM: STEP1 keep sample-type code '01'; STEP2 one per 12-char patient, keep lexicographically-lowest full aliquot barcode.

would_download_files_tsv.usage: source of the 507 pinned primary UUID+md5+size+barcode+mapped_4way.

gdc_manifest_full_tsv.usage: source of the 35 Solid-Tissue-Normal UUID+md5+size+barcode (sample_type=='Solid Tissue Normal' rows).

gdc_files_raw_json.usage: content-anchor cross-check: served Content-Disposition filename == GDC-recorded file_name per file_id.

step1_download_manifest.assertions: n_primary==507, n_normal==35, n_total==542, sum==2287429373, all uuid/md5 non-empty and unique -- ALL PASS.

step3_download_and_checksums.hard_stops: NONE (0 md5 mismatch, 0 size mismatch, 0 non-200)
step3_download_and_checksums.note_cr: download_and_verify.py wrote checksums.tsv with CRLF terminators (python csv default); the file was normalized to LF (values byte-identical) so it is pure-ASCII with no CR. The downloader's own internal assertion (542/542 md5+size, byte total exact) had already passed and it exited 0 before normalization.

step5_freeze_a_redux.gate_set: 507 PRIMARY files only (normals excluded from gate/selection/thresholds/labels)
step5_freeze_a_redux.content_anchor: all 542 served GDC filenames == GDC-recorded file_name (cohort membership re-derived from the ACTUAL materialized files, not the metadata prediction; barcode binding is metadata-intrinsic to GDC and is content-anchored via md5 + GDC filename).
step5_freeze_a_redux.dedup_note: The frozen tie-break fired 0 times HERE because the pinned 507-file set is already one-per-patient: task025 applied the SAME frozen rule to the full 553-primary cohort and its 4 tie patients (TCGA-BK-A0CA/A139/A26L/A0CC, 8 files dropped) are each present in the 507 as the KEPT lexicographically-lowest barcode. Re-applying the rule to the pinned winners is a verified no-op; all 4 confirmed non-POLE (NSMP/p53abn), so the tie-break lifts no marginal arm.
step5_freeze_a_redux.gate_band_rule: GREEN >=40 in every mandatory arm; YELLOW smallest 20-39; RED any <20. Smallest arm = 49 (POLE) -> GREEN. DERIVED; no number forced.
step5_freeze_a_redux.structural_check: each primary file: '# gene-model: GENCODE v36' header; data columns == [gene_id,gene_name,gene_type,unstranded,stranded_first,stranded_second,tpm_unstranded,fpkm_unstranded,fpkm_uq_unstranded]; 4 STAR summary rows [N_unmapped,N_multimapping,N_noFeature,N_ambiguous]; gene-row count == 60660. STRUCTURAL ONLY -- no tpm value scored.

normals_secondary_substrate.usage_constraint: VERIFY + PRESERVE ONLY. NOT in the gate, selection, thresholds, or labels. Adjacent/peri-tumoral Solid-Tissue-Normal: potentially affected by field effect + surgical ascertainment + small N. Reserved for a DEFERRED limited-B sensitivity; NOT used now.
normals_secondary_substrate.same_patient_subtype_labels: recorded in normals_preserved.tsv column same_patient_subtype_label (informational only; a normal sharing a 12-char patient with a subtype-labelled tumour is noted, never used to gate/label).

commands_run: sha256sum on the 4 frozen inputs + gdc_files_raw.json (all verified == expected)
curl -s https://api.gdc.cancer.gov/status -o release_status.json  (DR45.0 verified, no drift)
curl one-file connectivity+md5 sanity test on 007f9390-... (HTTP200, md5 match)
/usr/bin/python3 scripts/download_and_verify.py > download.log  -> originals/ (542 files) + checksums.tsv (542/542 md5+size, byte total exact)
/usr/bin/python3 scripts/freeze_a_redux.py  -> freeze_a_redux/ (Freeze A derived counts + structural validation + gate band GREEN)
